visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and a navy blue button-down shirt stands against a plain white wall. A banner at the top shows blue text on a white background with portraits of three men. (2) The scene cuts to a woman with her hair styled in a bun, wearing a white vintage lace dress and pearls, sitting at a dark wooden desk and writing with a quill. Three lit candles and dark glass bottles are in the background. The lighting is dim and warm, creating a historical atmosphere. (3) The man in the black shirt returns to the frame, gesturing with his hands. He wears a serious but engaged expression. The background remains the same plain white wall. (4) A portrait of King Henry VIII in royal attire appears, filling the frame. He wears a black hat and an ornate brown and gold coat with white fur trim. visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 東亞史探索課. [Slogan]: 升5-9年級專用! 不只中國史的跨文化視野. (2) [Subtitle]: 為什麼音樂課都要. [Variety]: 真的假的. (3) [Subtitle]: 在學校學直笛. (4) [Subtitle]: 可以說是跨越國際的共同回憶. (5) [Subtitle]: 不只是臺灣 香港 日本 中國 歐美國家也都是. (6) [Subtitle]: 其實在文藝復興時期. (7) [Subtitle]: 直笛可以說是貴族樂器. (8) [Subtitle]: 像是亨利八世他就收藏70多把直笛. (9) [Subtitle]: 巴哈韋瓦第這些大作曲家都為直笛譜寫樂譜. (10) [Subtitle]: 不過到18世紀出現的長笛. (11) [Subtitle]: 直笛慢慢沒落. (12) [Subtitle]: 直到20世紀才有一個教育家卡爾奧福. (13) [Subtitle]: 把直笛融入教育當中. (14) [Subtitle]: 慢慢的推廣到各級學校. (15) [Subtitle]: 什麼是奧福教學法. (16) [Subtitle]: 強調要透過遊戲舞蹈打擊樂. [Variety]: 遊戲🧸 舞蹈💃 打擊樂🥁. (17) [Subtitle]: 激發孩子的創造力. (18) [Subtitle]: 直笛可以很好的去配合打擊樂. (19) [Subtitle]: 在1969年有人從國外引進了奧福教學法. (20) [Subtitle]: 慢慢就普及在整個學校系統當中. (21) [Subtitle]: 留言「直笛」告訴你更多相關資訊.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A bright female voice asks why music classes require recorders, followed immediately by an energetic male narrator responding in a clear, professional studio tone. The background music is an upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic pop track with bright guitar strumming and a steady percussion beat. (2) A subtle bubble sound effect accompanies the visual transition. The male narrator maintains a high speech rate with dynamic pitch shifts, highlighting historical facts about the Renaissance. The acoustic guitar BGM remains constant in the background, providing a high-energy rhythmic floor. (3) A female voice briefly exclaims in a high-arousal, surprised tone. The narrator continues without pause, his voice clear and well-enunciated. The BGM tempo remains steady around 120 BPM, with no interference from ambient noise or digital distortion. (4) The narrator discusses the decline of the recorder and its 20th-century revival. His tone remains friendly and informative, with frequent upward inflections at the ends of descriptive phrases. The interplay between his crisp vocal delivery and the bright, major-key music creates a positive, educational vibe. (5) As the video nears its end, the narrator's volume increases slightly for the call to action. A final transition 'whoosh' is heard before the video cuts to silence. The production is studio-clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio throughout.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Historical Context -> Shift in Usage -> Modern Revival -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on the historical origins and evolution of the recorder as a staple of school music education, shifting its perception from a 'cheap classroom tool' to a historically significant 'noble instrument' revived through the Orff Schulwerk method.
